assumption_text: Compound climate hazards remain within the current adaptation planning envelope
revision_rule: Revise scenarios if index exceeds threshold for two consecutive reviews.

assumption_text: Public trust remains sufficient to support basic policy cooperation
revision_rule: Move to fragmentation scenario if trust divergence widens and participation declines.

assumption_text: Public AI accountability capacity can mature alongside deployment
revision_rule: Pause deployment assumptions if appeal failures increase.

assumption_text: Energy affordability and grid stress remain manageable through incremental policy
revision_rule: Shift to high-stress energy scenario if threshold is crossed.

assumption_text: Public finance can absorb repeated emergencies without crowding out prevention
revision_rule: Revise investment strategy if fiscal gap widens.
